summary: The Reconciliation section states that a nightly job compares ledger totals to the bank feed and opens a ticket on mismatch. The rest of the chunk is repeated boilerplate operational statements: structured logging with request ids, low-priority backfills, per-region dashboards, schema review for index impact, health and readiness endpoints, 90-day secret rotation, 200 ms p95 read latency target, single YAML config, alerts paging after five minutes, and a three-phase zero-downtime migration.

claims.text: A nightly job compares ledger totals against the bank feed and opens a ticket on any mismatch.
The migration ran in three phases over two weekends without downtime.
Latency targets stay under 200 ms at the 95th percentile for reads.
Secrets rotate every ninety days through the platform vault.
Alerts route to the payments channel and page after five minutes.
Every write path emits a structured log line with the request id.

risks.note: 200 ms p95 read target stated with no measurement or source.
Zero-downtime three-phase migration asserted without dates, evidence, or link.
Nightly reconciliation job described with no job name, schedule, or ticket system reference.

least_confident: The chunk is mostly repeated boilerplate sentences, so I could not tell which statements are specific to reconciliation versus generic filler.
